summary: Improve oil and gas project cost control with AACE estimating, EVM, risk forecasting, and digital dashboards. View the five-day course outline.
lede: Cost reduction strategies in oil and gas projects include stronger estimate and baseline control, commitment tracking, and timely cost forecasting. For cost engineers, project controls professionals, project managers, and commercial specialists, the course develops skills in assessing change orders, applying earned value and risk analysis, and preparing variance reports and dashboards for leadership decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyse, approve, or report oil and gas project expenditure across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and operations interfaces.
modules: Oil and Gas Cost Control Foundations
Integrated Cost Strategy and Executive Decisions
prerequisites: Working knowledge of project delivery, budgeting, or project controls in an engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, or operations environment is recommended. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic cost or schedule reports will help. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as Monte Carlo analysis, AI-assisted forecasting, and digital dashboard design are taught at operational application level rather than technical engineering level. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for exercises.
